'''Illiyana Spedding Brown''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Melbourne tournament (29 October)]] on 29 October 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Pod Profit]], according to Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3087">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-melbourne-oz-30-10-01d3087/ melbourne-oz-30-10-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 29 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-melbourne-oz-30-10-01d3087/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
